A '''Toydarian royal guard''' was present during [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] and Representative [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]]' [[The Matter of Using Toydarian Territory to Aid the Shipment of Relief Supplies to the Citizens of Ryloth/Legends|Mission on Toydaria]]. When Senator Organa landed on [[Toydaria/Legends|Toydaria]], he told the [[Toydarian royal guard]] to go back.

==Personality and traits==
Although this Toydarian stated that the Senator should turn back, they did offer to aid in any way for Bail to continue his journey.
